visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Layout never changes on a wide screen
visualizerParams.problemDescription: On a wide screen the sidebar and content should sit side by side, but they stay stacked. The media query asks for a width that is never reached.

solution.explanation: min-width: 6000px matches only screens at least 6000px wide, which does not exist. Typical breakpoints are 600px or 768px, a size where the layout starts to have enough room for columns.

checks.label: On a phone the blocks are stacked
On a wide screen the blocks share a row
